# AArch64 general-purpose groups: every form of every instruction, at the ends of each operand's
# range and somewhere inside it.
#
# The groups the table covers whole because no SIMD mnemonic shares
# them: the load/store exclusives, the acquire/release accesses, the
# atomics, and the pointer-authentication instructions that name a
# register.
#
# GNU as takes the zero register in either half of the 128-bit value a
# FEAT_THE `rcw<op>p` names (`rcwswpp xzr, x1, [x2]`) and llvm-mc does
# not; rsasm follows llvm-mc, as it does for every AArch64 encoding.
#
# Generated by tools/tables/aarch64.py, which took each line from a run of
# llvm-mc while measuring the encoding table; regenerate rather than edit. One
# instruction per line, compared a batch at a time by run.sh.
